items.item_text: Family Medicine Board Certified/Eligible OR Internal Medicine Board Certified/Eligible OR Med Peds Board Certified/Eligible

As a Physician with UCLA Health, UCan enjoy the close connection of community-focused patient care with the resources and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. We have openings for
board certified/eligible Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, and Med-Peds physicians within the Santa Clarita Valley
to view an extensive list of our clinics.
Provide both acute and convenience care to members of the local community
Utilize your full breadth of clinical skills to treat a diverse patient population
Collaborate with some of the world’s top physicians and researchers at the David Geffen School of Medicine
Work within a highly-innovative practice environment, including Epic Systems
Discover tremendous professional rewards with one of Forbes’ “Best In-State Employers”
Enjoy an excellent salary, incentive and benefits program
Experience California’s incredible variety of lifestyle advantages with our more than 280 locations
Grow your medical career with one of California’s top hospitals

North of the San Fernando Valley, the Santa Clarita Valley offers a blend of family-friendly communities, scenic beauty, and room to grow. Neighborhoods like Valencia, Stevenson Ranch, and Canyon Country are known for their top-rated schools, well-kept parks, and strong sense of community. The area is also home to an array of shopping centers, restaurants, and entertainment—including the thrills of Six Flags Magic Mountain. With easy freeway access, professionals can enjoy a quieter, suburban lifestyle without losing connection to Los Angeles. For those looking for more space and a welcoming atmosphere, Santa Clarita is a standout choice.
